name: Niacin
description: Nicotinic acid at pharmacological doses, approved for hyperlipidaemia. Outcome trials in statin-treated populations did not show added cardiovascular benefit. Also sold at nutritional doses as a dietary supplement.

systems.note: Lipid modification, raising HDL and lowering triglycerides; the labelled indication.
Hepatotoxicity is labelled and is markedly higher with sustained-release presentations.

monitors.why: Labelled hepatotoxicity, sharply higher on sustained-release forms.
The lipid fraction the drug most affects.
